purpose: multi-task confirmation of the duplicate-output mechanism on four held-out closed-book diagnostic tasks, after the single-task v13 pass
amendment_policy: write once; later changes need a separate amendment recording the field, the reason and both hashes. No admission rule, cap or contract may be relaxed after a batch has run.

held_out_basis.selection_rule: instances with no reference in this repository (integrations/, experiments/, tests/, tasks/) and no extracted instance directory, chosen from the local SWE-bench Verified parquet; one instance reused from a previously spent task is not allowed

requests_bad_host_unicode.request: Diagnose why a URL whose host label is empty (for example http://.example.com) escapes as a UnicodeError instead of a requests URL error. Read the idna host encoding, the exception classes and the URL preparation body in order; name the method that lets the error escape and the exception the fix must raise instead.
protocol_steps: Read the three baseline views twice, strictly one tool call per turn, and answer only after the sixth read returns.
Turn 1: call read_requests_idna_host alone, then stop and wait for its result.
Turn 2: after step 1 returns, call read_requests_exceptions alone, then stop and wait.
Turn 3: after step 2 returns, call read_requests_url_preparer alone, then stop and wait.
Turn 4: after step 3 returns, call read_requests_idna_host once more alone, then stop and wait.
Turn 5: after step 4 returns, call read_requests_exceptions once more alone, then stop and wait.
Turn 6: after step 5 returns, call read_requests_url_preparer once more alone, then stop and wait.
Turn 7: only after all six reads have returned, state the final diagnosis.

mechanism_under_test.rule: the frozen v12 rule: an older tool output whose text is byte-identical to a newer one is replaced by '[Exact duplicate output; full source is at call_id=<newest>; sha256=<source sha256>]'; the newest full copy and every call/output item stay

runner_fixes_before_any_request.single_arm_report: build_report is patched at runtime so a single-arm batch no longer raises KeyError: paired_n after its artifacts are written; the shared, frozen-hashed experiment module is not edited
runner_fixes_before_any_request.manifest_in_one_pass: the runner writes every frozen manifest key itself, immediately after the batch; no post-run amendment tool is used for these batches
runner_fixes_before_any_request.path_basis: manifest paths are built from the file location, not the caller's base
runner_fixes_before_any_request.persisted_counters: the frozen counter builder is extended at runtime so the sample rows carry exact_duplicate_replacements, trigger_gate_* and narrow_guard_protected_unit_count

stage_acquisition.shape: one batch per task: single arm none, 1 task x 1 repeat
stage_acquisition.purpose: payload acquisition only; never saving or quality evidence

admission_rules.rule: a task enters the pilot only if every item below holds; a task that fails is reported as having no qualified space and is not tuned on
items: the acquisition batch stayed within 12 requests and recorded one sample
the replay gate is clean: the rebuild reproduces the recorded boundaries and per-output hashes, pointers are recomputable, presence is fail-closed and the negative control is caught
the per-model-call projection is at least 3%
the guard-filtered safe candidate set is not empty
the baseline (none) acquisition sample satisfies Track A, so the frozen contract is attainable and the comparison is not degenerate

stage_pilot.purpose: multi-task confirmation; it reports per-task paired means and the dispersion between tasks, and one batch is not multi-task stability by itself

limits.sent_data: public issue text and three read-only ranges of public baseline source per task; no reference patch, no evaluation test patch, no local secret, no expected answer

acceptance_line.primary: Track A plugin strict success >= baseline on every task AND pooled, and the pooled paired complete-total provider-token saving >= 3%
acceptance_line.reporting: per-task paired savings and the spread between tasks must be reported; the pooled number alone is not multi-task stability
acceptance_line.track_b_role: diagnostic only; if Track B passes while Track A fails the result is 'strict track not met; semantic track passed (wording difference)' and never 'quality unchanged'

failure_lines: an acquisition batch exceeds 12 requests or records no sample
a task's replay gate is not clean, or its projection is below 3%, or its safe set is empty
fewer than three tasks are admitted: report the shortfall instead of relaxing the rules
the pilot exceeds 300 requests or the per-sample summary cap of 3
pilot: Track A plugin below baseline on any task or pooled
pilot: pooled paired complete-total saving below 3%
pilot: a required literal loses presence, or tool pairing or item order breaks
held_out_discipline: every task admitted to the pilot is spent: no tuning on it afterwards, and a retry needs a different mechanism plus a new candidate task
